hero.eyebrow: QNTBR · Custom software · Web, desktop and phone
hero.lede: QNTBR is a software studio. You tell us what slows your work down, and we design and build the app that fixes it. We make our apps with *Rusty Buns*, our own open-source toolkit. Every app on this page is live right now, and every picture is a real screenshot.
hero.facts: Browser · Desktop · Phone / Built on Cloudflare Workers / Open source on GitHub

feed.title: Work you can *try today.*
feed.lede: The first is codeSplitter, a home for the code that AI agents write. Below it are three games that we built with the same tools.

lab.title: Put two words together. *Get an app.*
lab.lede: We gave each game and app two words: an action and a thing. Drag one word onto the other and the app appears. Click the app to open it. Every app is also in the bag, if you want to pick one directly.

products.title: Tools for people who *write code.*
products.lede: codeSplitter keeps the code that AI agents write. Rusty Buns is the toolkit that we build and release our apps with. The other tools here are made with both.

services.title: Work we do *for your business.*
services.lede: This is the work that businesses hire us for. We use the same tools that made everything on this page.

webapps.title: Web apps
webapps.text: An app that your team or your customers open in a browser, with nothing to install. When one person makes a change, everyone else sees it immediately.

architecture.title: Solutions architecture
architecture.text: Before we write code, we choose the parts of your system and decide how they connect. The result stays online and costs little to operate.

warehouse.title: Custom warehouse integrations
warehouse.text: We connect your warehouse system to your store, your customer records (CRM) and your shipping carriers. Nobody copies data through a spreadsheet.

threepl.title: 3PL app integrations
threepl.text: A 3PL is a company that stores and ships your products for you. We send your orders to it, and bring tracking numbers and stock counts back to every place where you sell.

dropship.title: Drop shipping integrations
dropship.text: In drop shipping, the supplier sends the product directly to your customer. We send each item in an order to the supplier that ships it, and keep stock and tracking correct in your store.

desktop.title: Desktop apps from web apps
desktop.text: With *Rusty Buns*, your web app becomes one file. Double-click the file and the app runs on your computer, with its server inside.

games.title: Games you can *play now.*
games.lede: The games that we built with Rusty Buns. You can also draft the Magic: The Gathering cube, the project where QNTBR started.

apps.title: Apps for *real work.*
apps.lede: A sample CRM for customer records, packing and shipping tools, Qlave for calls, Flareup to monitor Cloudflare costs, Staticflare for hosting, one login for every app, and a workshop of smaller apps.

about.label: About
about.text: QNTBR is a *software studio*. A person or a business tells us about a problem, and we design and build the software that solves it. We use our own tools every day, so we know that they work. Our goal is software that works, arrives quickly and is easy to use.
